performance.verdict: Ads went dark Aug 6 — 17 days zero spend, zero leads.

findings.text: Meta spend has been $0 every day since Aug 6 (17 consecutive zero-spend days); all 38 leads and $884.84 spend belong to the pre-dark period.
3-day lead signal (Aug 3–5): 1+4+4=9 leads vs prior 3 days (Jul 31–Aug 2): 1+1+3=5 leads — campaign was improving before it went dark, making the blackout costlier.
GBP actions dropped 67% 7d vs prior 7d (from ~49 to ~16 actions); last 3 days show 0, 0, 0 — organic referral traffic also collapsing without paid halo.
GHL shows 30 contacts but 0 opportunities created and 0 appointments in 28 days — intake pipeline is not converting contacts to opps regardless of lead volume.
IG reach spiked +13,100% 7d (264 total reach) but spend is $0 — this is organic/residual impression noise, not a real signal; daily verdict over-indexed on it.

suggestions.text: Immediately diagnose and restore Meta spend — 17 zero-spend days are confirmed; restore to $65/day minimum.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta has been at $0 spend every day since Aug 6 — 17 consecutive days of no delivery across all campaigns. The account was trending upward (9 leads in the 3 days before blackout vs 5 in the 3 prior) so this blackout is actively costing leads at a baseline CPL of $23.29. Action: Hamza/Hamdan to diagnose today — check account payment status, campaign disapprovals, and billing threshold. Restore to minimum $65/day on CROA || CBO - 3/17/26 immediately. Success check: spend > $0 confirmed in platform by Aug 23 EOD.

suggestions.text: Flag GHL intake gap to Andrew — 30 contacts, 0 opportunities created; this is an intake process failure, not an ads problem.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 30 contacts received over 28 days but zero opportunities created and zero appointments booked — leads are arriving but not being worked. This is an intake process failure on the client side (Andrew/Joy), not an ads attribution issue. Action: Sohib to flag to Marwan and Andrew that opp creation workflow is broken; request confirmation of GHL pipeline stage rules and response SLA. Success check: at least 1 opportunity created per 3 contacts received within 5 business days of restoration, confirmed by Aug 28.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP recovery after paid spend restores — 67% GBP drop is probable paid-halo collapse, not standalone organic decline.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions fell 67% week-over-week (roughly 49 to 16 actions) and hit 0 for the last 3 tracked days, likely driven by the loss of paid traffic halo rather than organic search decline. No action on GBP itself is warranted yet. Re-check GBP 7d actions on Aug 27 — if paid spend is restored by Aug 23 and GBP does not recover above 20 actions/week by Aug 27, escalate as a standalone organic issue.
